scan_scope: All CSV headers, JSON object keys, viewer JSON payload keys, exact public model/row schemas, CSV-viewer agreement, QC partitions, local-path and common credential patterns, and prohibited files. This audit does not establish legal rights or detect every possible secret/identifying value.
replay_evidence_scope: Both complete public variant tables were replayed during preparation. The final audit reconfirmed unchanged byte hashes for all 5,119 released data/model/station-payload files. Public inference-core changes during finalization were limited to copyright/SPDX comments; no formulas or parameters changed. The final structural scan did not repeat that replay.

validator_adversarial_tests.scope: Isolated temporary fixtures: measured-Q fields, ground-pair metadata, training statistics, private paths, common credentials, prohibited files, root/nested Git metadata, and legitimate public satellite fields and explanatory prose.
